description: Public Print validation rejects incompatible spiral copies and prime-tower layering and warns when support enforcers are inactive.

mutants.description: Two spiral-vase copies in by-layer sequence must be rejected; the one-copy control remains valid.
A two-object prime-tower print must reject a 0.1 mm per-object layer-height mismatch and preserve the equal-height positive control.
An unused support-enforcer volume warns when support is disabled, while enabling support suppresses the warning; a blocker never warns.
